_why: An installer recipe: the three facts nobody can derive from a supplier's setup file — the silent switches, the DETECTION RULE, and the uninstall path. See docs/windows-management.md §5b.
name: acme-widget
label: Acme Widget

source._why: The file this hash pins lives at fixtures/acme-widget-setup.bat in this repository. It used to be an ad-hoc file in /tmp, which meant the milestone's proof could not be repeated once the file was gone — a checksum whose subject nobody can produce any more documents nothing.

detect.name: Version
detect._why: Version EQUALS 4.2.1, not merely 'the key exists': an upgrade must read as a change, and existence alone would report an old version as already installed.

uninstall._why: Nothing to append: the recorded UninstallString removes the product on its own. The field exists because `arguments` (the SILENT-INSTALL switches) must not be reused here — measured: /S appended to the uninstall command made Windows refuse it as invalid syntax.
